Eagles 53-Man Roster Prediction: Offseason Edition 

Some thoughts:

** Even though there is a QB competition at backup QB I could see Andy Dalton landing on the practice squad. More likely to be cut and put on the PS than McKee or Payton

** The plan at tight end could very well be: Keep Goedert, Stowers, Mundt and then cut the rest/see who makes it through waivers and go TE heavy on the practice squad

** I have them keeping Elijah Moore because they want to be deep at WR and I think he could potentially go elsewhere if cut

** Willie Lampkin is very much on the bubble but I think they will want to keep developmental OL players and he very well could get claimed (by the Rams)

** Backup DT outside the top 3 is one of the hardest places to make cuts on the roster

** Still think they will probably add a veteran safety 

** Plus the obvious Elliott/Mann/Underwood on ST. I think they keep Underwood if they decide he’s the LS and don’t get cute with the practice squad possibility
